paper.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
paper.abstract: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction. (예시 초록)
paper.one_liner: A memory extraction method that separates who should remember what in multi-user, multi-agent chats

detail.what: Proposes extracting personal, group and agent-level memories separately from conversations.
detail.novelty: Makes the owner and scope of each memory explicit.
detail.why: Reduces team chatbots mixing up other people's information.
detail.apply: Useful when designing per-user and per-team memory keys for an internal assistant bot.
